title: Example 006 (B9, Box Office Java verifier) gains its replay record
description: build.py now runs jvmcontract equivalence with --json and reads the library's Outcome instead of its console text (build-orchestration brief, step 1c). The verdict must agree with the exit code, and the result gains search (engine, checker, seconds, bounds, input range, shared callees, the own checker's path and solver numbers) and replay (where the witness was replayed: jvmcontract's bytecode interpreter), and a violation's counterexample gains found and shrinkRuns. The page now says the witness was replayed in jvmcontract's bytecode interpreter, not on the JVM. Example 006 runs the Box Office Java verifier, which replays its witness on the JVM: it keeps its text path, records replay.by jvm, and its page keeps saying 'on the JVM'.
expected: example 006 gives its expected violation: build.py prints 'as expected' and exits 0

resources.notes: a Box Office B9 example: Gradle build of the module and the Java verifier, under a minute
